checks.result: 90000 valid synthetic OB callbacks + 7106 frozen observed frames, separate original/current native stream and stores. Actual blocked socket, coalesced pending-state recovery, final parent/native cache exact; 44 durable files byte equal. Actual original snapshot creation and recovery wall time recorded.

Two separate spawn sender/parent trials; canonical JSON SHA and 400000 record points matched. Traced sender peak 39203084B -> 1039750B; parent peak 120451754B -> 101253948B. Source tree built before tracing, RSS recorded separately.
100 socket roundtrip/release cycles, 2000 points per side, all matched. Natural GC only; retained traced 24031B at 10 vs 26925B at 100. No increasing encoded outbox or partial-tree cache.

reuse_scope: Full suite includes all final executable production/test logic. A read-ahead explanatory comment was added after full-suite start; final affected 112 and Ruff include it. Probe-only capture timing instrumentation was then added and its capture path rerun. Transport/process/lifecycle implementations and production behavior used by prior measurements are unchanged. Baseline f06ba91d4 frontend-only changes do not affect these Python measurements. Original callback baseline independently loaded from 97b3ffe03.

environment.gc: No forced collections, disabling or freeze. Natural gen0 counts included (large case monolithic 1 vs chunked 7); no gen1/gen2 collection during short individual transfer samples.

limits: No production server restart, credential inheritance, vendor authentication or new live vendor capture. Worktree .env empty. Frozen observed input replayed through real callbacks and writers.

Operational state stays atomic and fail-closed. Existing 10s freshness, 30s RPC timeout and 512 peak key cap retained. Sustained backpressure can cause explicit not-ready/timeouts; partial arrays never published.
Only transient serialization/read-ahead is bounded. Complete native/snapshot/parent caches remain O(history); valid scalar/point fields must fit a frame and max path depth is 16.
Monolithic comparison is a measurement-only uncapped baseline; old production path does not succeed for >8MiB logical peaks.
Not a pre-API losslessness guarantee, fleet-wide/long-term RSS, natural gen2 or live vendor-to-storage p99 measurement. Small histories cost ~0.23ms extra in sample and gen0 frequency increases.
